Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01HqH4BQkTREV1QyHMkpCbWg

feat(tools): shared manifest, week-over-week diff, unified dashboard scoring

- tools/lib/manifest.mjs: single source of truth for managed files, type
  detection, .consistency-ignore handling and per-repo evaluation; used by
  both sync-configs.mjs and dashboard.mjs so their numbers always agree
- sync-configs.mjs: --since-last (make changes) diffs against
  .consistency-snapshot.json (new repos, newly missing, new drift, fixes);
  --json for machine-readable state; --drift lists drift only; files listed
  in .consistency-ignore may also be deliberately absent
- dashboard.mjs: scores the full manifest, grouped columns, missing-files
  and no-CI cards (CI now checked for every repo type), NEW badge
- .gitignore: ignore every top-level folder except tools/ so new clones
  never show up as untracked
